title: Chief Executive Order 16 Appointment Of Federal Ministers And Oath Of Office Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 16 Appointment Of Federal Ministers And Oath Of Office Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

APPOINTMENT OF FEDERAL MINISTERS AND OATH OF OFFICE (AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2002
APPOINTMENT OF FEDERAL MINISTERS AND OATH
OF OFFICE (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER N0.16 OF 2002
An Order further
to amend the Appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 1, 21st June, 20021
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
21-6-2002.--The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Appointment of Federal
Ministers and Oath of Office (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 16 Appointment Of Federal Ministers And Oath Of Office Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 1999

APPOINTMENT OF FEDERAL MINISTERS AND OATH OF OFFICE (AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2002
APPOINTMENT OF FEDERAL MINISTERS AND OATH
OF OFFICE (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER N0.16 OF 2002
An Order further
to amend the Appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 1, 21st June, 20021
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
21-6-2002.--The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Chief
Executive's Order No.7 of 1999.--In the Federal Ministers and Oath of Office
Order, 1999 (Order N6.7 of 1999),--
(a) In the preamble, after the
words "Federal Ministers" the words "and Ministers of
State" shall be inserted;
(b) In Article. 4, after the
words "Federal Ministers" the Words "and Ministers of
State" shall be inserted;
(c) In Article 7, after the words
"Federal Ministers" the words "or Ministers of State" shall
be inserted;
(d) In Article 8, after the words
"Federal Ministers" the words "and Ministers of State"
shall be inserted;
(e) In Article 9, after the words
"Federal Ministers." the words "or a Minister of State"
shall be inserted;
(f) In Article 10, after the
words "Federal Ministers" the words "or a Minister of
State" shall be inserted;
(g) In the Schedule, after the
words "Federal Ministers" occurring twice, the brackets and the words
"(or Minister of State)" shall be inserted.
